    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AnnotatedElements
    The elements a Step gets in a round, by annotation, and by meta-annotation for the step's meta-annotations.
    Annotation
    An annotation to write, such as @Override or @SuppressWarnings({"unchecked", "rawtypes"}).
    Annotation.Builder
    A builder of Annotations.
    AnnotationReader
    Reads the values of an annotation, defaults included, with the types they are declared with.
    ApplicationDirectories
    The directories where one application stores its files: its own subdirectories of the platform's Directories, one for each kind of file, never shared with another kind.
    ArrayTypeName
    The name of an array type, such as String[].
    AtomicFiles
    Writes files atomically: a reader sees either the previous content of a file or its new content, never a part of it, and so does the next run of a program after a crash.
    AtomicFiles.Output
    Writes the content of a file to a stream.
    ByteSink
    A writable destination of bytes, such as a file, that opens a new stream each time it is written.
    ByteSource
    A readable source of bytes, such as a file or a URL, that opens a new stream each time it is read.
    CharSink
    A writable destination of characters, such as a text file, that opens a new stream each time it is written.
    CharSource
    A readable source of characters, such as a text file or a string, that opens a new stream each time it is read.
    ClassName
    The name of a class, interface, enum, record or annotation type, possibly nested in others.
    CodeBlock
    A fragment of code: statements, an expression, or Javadoc text, with placeholders for the types and names it refers to.
    CodeBlock.Builder
    A builder of CodeBlocks.
    Compilation
    The outcome of a TestCompiler run: whether it succeeded, every diagnostic, and every generated file.
    CompilationAssert
    AssertJ assertions on a Compilation.
    CompilationExtension
    Gives tests the Elements and Types of a running compilation, to test code that works on javax.lang.model without writing an annotation processor around it.
    Configuration
    How a memory file system behaves: its path style, roots, working directory, capacity, name matching, attribute views, default attributes, clock and features.
    Configuration.Builder
    A builder of Configurations.
    DiagnosticAssert
    AssertJ assertions on the diagnostics of a Compilation that matched an earlier assertion, such as CompilationAssert.hadErrorContaining(String).
    Diagnostics
    Reports errors, warnings and notes at a precise place in the source: an element, one of its annotations, or one attribute of that annotation.
    Directories
    The base directories where applications store their files, as defined by the XDG Base Directory Specification.
    Environment
    A source of environment variables: the running JVM's, or fixed ones for tests.
    FakeDirectories
    Directories under one root directory, such as a test's temporary directory, so that code under test never touches the real ones.
    FakeDirectories.Builder
    Builds FakeDirectories.
    FakePlatform
    A Platform with the operating system of your choice and its directories under a root directory, such as a test's temporary directory.
    FakePlatform.Builder
    Builds a FakePlatform.
    FakeTicker
    A Ticker that only moves when told to, so that tests of timing code are exact and instant.
    Feature
    An optional capability of a file system.
    Field
    A field, such as private static final int LIMIT = 10;.
    Field.Builder
    A builder of Fields.
    GeneratedSources
    Writes the Java source files a processor generates, with their package declaration and imports: modelled as a JavaFile, or written as text.
    HashMultiset<E>
    A modifiable multiset backed by a HashMap, the multiset counterpart of HashSet.
    JavaFile
    A Java source file: a package, one top-level type, and the imports they need, which are worked out when the file is written.
    JavaFile.Builder
    A builder of JavaFiles.
    MemoryFileSystems
    Creates file systems in memory.
    Method
    A method, a constructor, or the compact constructor of a record.
    Method.Builder
    A builder of Methods.
    MoreCollectors
    Collectors that Collectors does not provide.
    MoreElements
    Navigation, casts and checks on Elements that javax.lang.model does not provide.
    MoreGatherers
    Gatherers that Gatherers does not provide.
    MoreTypes
    Checks and conversions on TypeMirrors that javax.lang.model does not provide.
    Multiset<E>
    A collection that counts how many times it contains each element: its occurrences.
    Multiset.Entry<E>
    An element of a multiset with its count.
    Multisets
    Static factories and a collector for unmodifiable multisets that iterate in the order their elements first appear, with all occurrences of an element in a row: multiset("foo", "bar", "foo") iterates over foo, foo, bar.
    NameAllocator
    Hands out Java identifiers that do not clash: each new name is the suggestion, made a valid identifier, with as many underscores appended as needed to differ from the keywords and the names already handed out.
    NameMatching
    How the names of the files of a directory are matched when they are looked up.
    OperatingSystem
    The operating systems a Platform can tell apart: one for each of Platform.isLinux(), Platform.isMacOS() and Platform.isWindows(), and one for the other Unix-like systems, for which all three are false.
    Parameter
    A parameter of a method or constructor, or a component of a record, such as final String name.
    Parameter.Builder
    A builder of Parameters.
    ParameterizedTypeName
    The name of a parameterized type, such as Map<String, List<Integer>>, or of an inner class whose enclosing type has type arguments or annotations, such as Outer<String>.Inner.
    PathStyle
    How the paths of a file system are written: their separators, roots and the characters their names may have.
    Platform
    The platform the JVM runs on: its operating system and the directories applications use on it.
    Platform.Builder
    Detects a Platform from its sources.
    PlatformPreset
    The system properties and environment variables a JVM typically has on an operating system, to detect a Platform from, so that tests run the real detection of the directories of any operating system:
    PlatformPreset.Builder
    Builds a PlatformPreset.
    Preconditions
    Checks that a method is called correctly, and throws the matching exception if not.
    PrimitiveTypeName
    The name of a primitive type, or void.
    ProcessingContext
    Everything a processor works with: javac's processing environment, and gaia's helpers on top of it.
    ProcessingException
    An error in the source, thrown to stop processing an element and report the error at a precise place: the element, one of its annotations, or one attribute of that annotation, as Diagnostics reports it.
    ProcessorAssert
    AssertJ assertions on an annotation processor class.
    ProcessorOption<T>
    An option of an annotation processor, given to javac as -Aname=value, with its type and default value.
    ServiceFiles
    Writes the service files ServiceLoader reads on the class path: META-INF/services/<service>, listing the implementations of a service, one binary name per line.
    Sets
    Static factories and a collector for unmodifiable sets that iterate in the order their elements are given.
    SharedCompilation
    Makes CompilationExtension share one compilation across all the tests of the annotated class, and its nested classes, instead of starting one per test.
    SortedMultiset<E>
    A multiset that keeps its elements sorted, by their natural ordering or by a comparator: the multiset counterpart of NavigableSet.
    SourceScope
    The names a generated source file uses, and the imports they need: a GeneratedSources.write(JavaFile, Element...) body gets one to name the types it refers to.
    Splitter
    Splits text into parts around a separator: a character, a literal string or a regular expression.
    Step
    One unit of work of a StepProcessor: the processing of the elements annotated with some annotations, or with annotations that some meta-annotations annotate.
    StepProcessor
    An annotation processor made of Steps, which takes care of processing rounds.
    Stopwatch
    Measures elapsed time, on a Ticker rather than on the wall clock.
    SystemProperties
    A source of system properties: the running JVM's, or fixed ones for tests.
    TestCompiler
    Compiles in-memory sources with the system Java compiler, in process, running the given annotation processors.
    Throwables
    Creates exceptions from the exception that caused them.
    Ticker
    A source of nanosecond time, for measuring elapsed time: only the difference between two readings is meaningful.
    TreeMultiset<E>
    A modifiable sorted multiset backed by a TreeMap, the multiset counterpart of TreeSet.
    Type
    A class, interface, enum, record or annotation type, or an anonymous class.
    Type.Builder
    A builder of Types.
    Type.Kind
    The kinds of type.
    TypeKey
    A TypeMirror with the equals and hashCode of the type it denotes, for use in sets and maps: TypeMirror itself does not define them, and two mirrors of List<String> need not be equal.
    TypeName
    The name of a type as it is written in source code: a primitive, a class, a parameterized type, an array, a type variable or a wildcard, possibly with type annotations such as @Nullable.
    TypeVariableName
    The name of a type variable, such as T.
    Visibility
    How widely an element can be accessed, as its access modifier, or the lack of one, says: see MoreElements.visibility(javax.lang.model.element.Element) and MoreElements.effectiveVisibility(javax.lang.model.element.Element).
    WildcardTypeName
    The name of a wildcard type argument: ?, ? extends T or ? super T.
